sha_model.evidence_base_meaning: The commit the comparison TARGET is pinned to, and whose dispositions this protocol consumed. See target-pin-v1.1.json.
sha_model.protocol_current_revision_sha: recorded by the committing revision; not knowable from inside the commit it describes
sha_model.pr_head_sha: PR #445 head at read time; not a protocol constant
sha_model.self_reference_limitation: A manifest cannot contain the hash of the commit containing it, and cannot hash itself. Artifact hashes are content hashes; the manifest's own integrity is checked via git, not self-hash.

file_model.why_hashed_is_one_fewer: The manifest cannot hash itself: writing the hash changes the bytes it hashes. It is excluded from its own list and its integrity is checked via git.
file_model.note: Earlier revisions said 'fourteen artifacts' ambiguously: REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS excluded the verifier while the manifest excluded itself, naming different sets.
file_model.hashing_rule: Hashes a DECLARED LIST, never a directory scan. A scan would silently admit stray files such as __pycache__ contents.
